Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 32 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Rajesh - 31 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
3. Hema - 28 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The restaurant - round tables, soft light
2. The potter's yard - a wheel, clay pots

Scene 1: The restaurant - Day

[Karan stands in the restaurant. Rajesh and Hema stand near him.]

Karan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Karan sits at the table and eats.]

Karan (happily): "Careful!"

[Karan sips his coffee.]

Hema (gently): "That's easy."

[Karan raises his glass of wine for a toast.]

Karan (happily): "Really?"

Scene 2: The potter's yard - Day

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[Karan shapes a clay pot on the potter's wheel.]

Karan: "Really?"

[Karan paints the clay lamps.]

Karan: "I really enjoyed today."
